notes.title: Tips, Steam Next Fest and New Update v0.3.9
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993040/2dcc500b5f1c3194cee0419c631a66e4b47aa361.jpg"][/img]
Hey, developer is here!
First, I am very happy to see people trying the demo during Next Fest and leaving feedback! I check and read every single comment and piece of advice. Demo is [b]updated to v0.3.9,[/b] and that's the last update before early access. Here are some of the tips and notes to make the experience with Radioactivity the best.[/p][h1][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434810/Radioactivity__Onboarding/"][/dynamiclink]
Tips[/h1][h2]
Weapons and Reloading:[/h2][p]Gun handling might seem daunting at first, but don't fear, it can be mastered and done times faster than any usual animation in common shooters. Here is a secret for keyboard users:  

Hot keys for inventory will select items of the next categories in sequence: 
1 - Weapons 
2 - Tools 
3 - Magazines  

So load that magazine beforehand, pick up the pistol
[b]To do the fastest reloading of all shooter games, you can press the next sequence:[/b]
1 -> Q -> Left Mouse Button -> Q -> R

It gets way cooler with practice![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993040/e2b263221de015738b2dfce75cfdfc65398f352e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Collecting Radioactive Crystals:[/h2][p]If it's hard to find crystals in the forest, [b]wait till the night[/b] (later skip day will be introduced when deployed). Crystals glow and are very easy to find when it's dark. 

Also, don't forget to check Crystal Resonance on a hand watch, it tells how many are still around (not exactly, so 1 small crystal is aprox. 3.3 dB)[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993040/6a057437730807491aff1f85d6ef16a4dafc6a77.gif"][/img]
[/h1][h1]Update V0.3.9:[/h1][list][*][p]Sounds and footsteps rebalance [/p][/*][*][p]Some quality of life to demo's objectives[/p][/*][*][p]New mutant[/p][/*][*][p]Control point forest is more dangerous[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Geiger detection of radiation

[/p][/*][/list][h1]Quick Q&A:[/h1][p][b]Does Radioactivity Onboarding reflect the actual full game?[/b]
- Yes, and no, the demo is more of a semi-linear intro into a game world. There are no deployments into the actual exclusion area yet. However, the main mechanics and general feel are well demonstrated and will be improved based on the feedback.[/p][p][b]
Why demo is so short?
[/b]- Sorry, I don't want to rush things and release an "experience that lacks that experience", if you know what I mean. Deployments, actual objectives, and atmosphere are being cooked and will be released in a better shape. Plus, all the feedback. [/p][p]
[b]Stalker but multiplayer?
[/b]- Well, almost, with bits of Pacific Drive. But I envision no anomalies, instead a very dynamic nature that is interactive and feels like part of the game, fauna and mutants leave their life, not just spawn in front of a player, and "sectors" - areas that players deploy to, are all procedural and dynamic. They change visually based on pollution, and hence, flora and fauna change too.
[/p]

notes.title: ☢️ Radioactivity - Onboarding v0.3.5 ☢️
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Demo Update: Patches v0.3.4 & v0.3.5 Deployed![/h2]

Hey again, future Liquidators!

Hope you're surviving the onboarding process! Thanks for jumping into the Early Demo and sharing your initial thoughts and bug reports – it's incredibly helpful.

I've been busy "liquidating" some of the bugs and adding a few improvements over the last few days. Patches [b]v0.3.4[/b] and [b]v0.3.5[/b] are now live!

Here’s a quick rundown of what’s changed:

[h3]Key Fixes & Improvements (v0.3.4 & v0.3.5):[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Engine Upgrade:[/b] I've moved the project to [b]Unreal Engine 5.5[/b]! This is a background change that helps with future development and stability
[list]
  [*] General graphic performance improved slightly.
  [*] ! Finally fixed an issue where game won't start on some of the older hardware !
[/list]
[*] [b]Voice Chat Enhancements:[/b] Added much-needed microphone controls! You can now select your input device, adjust gain, etc. 
[*] [b]Interaction Bug:[/b] Fixed the issue where players joining a game couldn't interact with anything until they paused and unpaused. 
[*] [b]Crash Fixes:[/b] Resolved crashes related to dropping invisible prop items when training failed and interacting with prop meteorites in multiplayer. 
[*] [b]Gameplay & Visual Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
  [*] Changes to the outdoor environment with colours, shadows and extra fog.
  [*] Fixed door to the scaffolding area.
  [*] Corrected ammo count display issues on the pistol and fixed visuals for empty magazines.
  [*] Ensured all players teleport correctly during training transitions.
  [*] Removed a strange flying magazine texture that could appear after training.
  [*] Fixed a visual glitch with pager/watch display icon
  [*] Addressed an issue where players could talk after death.
  [*] Slightly reduced the forward camera tilt when sprinting.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Option:[/b] Added an Invert Mouse option in the settings.
[*] [b]Optimization:[/b] Improved performance related to large flashlight shadows.
[/list]

This is all part of getting the Early Demo polished based on your experiences. Please keep the feedback and bug reports coming via the Steam forums or Discord – they're invaluable as I continue development.

Remember, this demo is just the first step. There is already work started on the Early Access version with actual core gameplay loop, follow to not miss new updates!

Stay safe out there (or try to!),

- Thomas B.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434810/Radioactivity__Onboarding/

notes.title: Radioactivity - Onboarding Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]☢ Welcome to the Early Demo of Radioactivity![/h1]

Hey future Liquidators!

Big event and announcement! Radioactivity Onboarding - demo is [b]finally out and free to play[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434810/Radioactivity__Onboarding

You must complete an onboarding process as a fresh candidate. Being a liquidator means getting your hands dirty with radioactive mess, literally! It's dynamic, it changes the nature around! It can harm you, of course, as well as mutated beings that adapted to it.

This is your first chance to explore the world and gameplay systems being built, and your feedback will help shape what’s next. Go ahead and give it a good vibe check! Of course, it's nowhere near perfect and as polished as I would like it to be, but hey, we are getting there and getting there fast ;) 

[h2]Why Early Demo Release?[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Understand what we as gamers [b]like and don't like[/b]. Directly, no fluff or publishers in between me and you.
[*] Building a project with this scope means focusing on quality step by step, which means lots of feedback is required.
[*] Together we can shape it better, and in the meantime, I can polish each part and make sure it all feels right and everybody enjoys it the same way we enjoyed gaming back in the good old days ; ) 
[/olist]

[h2]What the Demo Is — and Isn't[/h2]

[b]What it is:[/b] 
[list] [*]A [b]linear, objective-driven experience[/b] to showcase core gameplay mechanics. [*]A [b]technical test[/b] to refine performance, stability, and gameplay flow. [/list]
[b]What it isn't:[/b] 
[list] [*]It's not what the actual core gameplay loop will be. [*]It's not yet a procedural open world sandbox — where your team need to plan each deployment, analyze, and survive [i]this all will come later![/i] [/list]

[h2]Inspired By What's Missing[/h2]

We millennials all remember this excitement of older video game titles, every game introduced something new and unique back then. [b]Radioactivity[/b] is a creative and ambitious endeavour, built to fill a gap that I felt was missing in the survival horror and co-op space.

Think of good old S.T.A.L.K.E.R., but multiplayer, an Arma approach to strategic gameplay, combined with goodies from recent popular co-op horror genres like Lethal Company and R.E.P.O., sandboxing and creativity on top. Yummy.

[h2]What's Included in the Demo[/h2]

[list] 
[*] Unique semi-realistic gun handling mechanics
[*] Dynamic radiation (although not as obvious as it will be in the full game)
[*] Early hazard mechanics and a mutant 
[*] A few early tools to help you do the job
[*] Proximity voice chat
[/list]

[h2]What's Coming (Roadmap)[/h2]

Future [b]Demo[/b] updates will bring: 
[list] 
[*] Some of the new mechanics and gameplay systems that will be part of the full game
[*] Expanded environments and hazards 
[*] Performance and stability improvements 
[*] And of course, more Geiger counters
[/list]
(🚧 Stay tuned for update announcements!)

[h2]Early Access: The Bigger Picture[/h2]

In Early Access, [b]Radioactivity[/b] will grow into: [list] 
[*]A [b]dynamic open world[/b] where every run feels different 
[*]Dynamic radiation - it moves, it is localized and global, it can be controlled or let loose
[*]Strategic deployments to the radioactive wilderness, what steps, what area shall we cover next to reduce overall pollution and the consequences it brings
[*]Day and night make a difference; stay in the exclusion area to figure out how 
[*]Flora and fauna are also dynamic and well, not as friendly as it look sometimes
[/list]
The onboarding demo you’re playing today is the first step toward that much larger world.

[h2]Few known Issues (Being Worked On)[/h2]
[list] 
[*][b]Demo is stuck on loading[/b]: Some older PC setups may have trouble launching the demo, the game freezes during load and never starts. It's an engine issue, unfortunately, but there are ways to fix it
[*][b]Menu Freezing[/b]: Rarely, the in-game pause menu might become unresponsive. Temporarily can be fixed by opening and closing it a few times
[/list]

(Anything else is being tracked and patched ASAP)

[h2]Let's Build It Together[/h2]

As any developer will tell you, your feedback, bug reports, and wishlist will [b]truly shape[/b] where Radioactivity is heading, but I am working on it as a project of passion, being a gamer myself, I value creative endeavour in such genres, polished gameplay mechanics that gets more OP with skill, and well, grim rainy survival with a few friends..

Thanks for being here at the start — looking forward to hearing what you think and building something unforgettable together!

[i]- Thomas B.[/i]

notes.title: First Update from the Radioactivity
notes.content:
[h2]Hello future Liquidators,[/h2]

Before you fill out your first safety form and are allowed to enter the zone, I would like to introduce you to the game first.

[h2]Radioactivity[/h2]
In Radioactivity, you alone or with friends will step into the shoes of a Liquidator, a brave individual who helps the State find, collect, and dispose of radioactive waste. You'll also have opportunities to earn some income along the way (isn't that why you decided to go to the zone in the first place?). 

I also acquired this document recently:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993040/17ef7625c02eaecc8b053a9a52e43550d7ec66e1.png[/img]

I'll be sharing more details about the game in August. It's a big game of course, I hope to announce a demo that will be playable a bit before or during the first week of September 2024. And if everything plays well, the demo itself will be [b]free[/b].

But for now, I just wanted to say hello and welcome you to the community. Feel free to ask questions, share your thoughts, and get ready for a radioactive adventure!

See you in the Zone,

[b]Don't forget to wishlist the game![/b]
